---
title: "Exploration"
---

Use the dropdown menu below to select a president and explore presidential approval, congressional approval, and party favorability trends over their administration.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load monthly approval and favorability datasets
monthly_data <- read_csv("data/presidential_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = fct_reorder(president, year_month, .fun = min))

congress_data <- read_csv("data/congressional_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = factor(president, levels = levels(monthly_data$president)))

party_data <- read_csv("data/party_favorability_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = factor(president, levels = levels(monthly_data$president)))

presidents <- levels(monthly_data$president)

fig <- plot_ly()

# Add traces for each president (defaulting to the first president visible)
for (i in seq_along(presidents)) {
  pres <- presidents[i]
  m_sub <- monthly_data |> filter(president == pres)
  c_sub <- congress_data |> filter(president == pres)
  p_sub <- party_data |> filter(president == pres)

  is_visible <- (i == 1)
  party_color <- if (m_sub$party[1] == "Democrat") "#2E74C0" else "#CB454A"

  fig <- fig |>
    add_trace(
      data = m_sub,
      x = ~year_month,
      y = ~approval,
      name = paste(pres, "(President)"),
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = party_color, width = 2.5),
      marker = list(color = party_color, size = 5),
      visible = is_visible,
      hovertemplate = paste0("<b>", pres, "</b><br>Date: %{x}<br>Approval: %{y}%<extra></extra>")
    ) |>
    add_trace(
      data = c_sub,
      x = ~year_month,
      y = ~approval,
      name = "Congress Approval",
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      connectgaps = TRUE,
      line = list(color = "#7B2CBF", width = 2),
      marker = list(color = "#7B2CBF", size = 5),
      visible = is_visible,
      hovertemplate = "<b>Congress</b><br>Date: %{x}<br>Approval: %{y}%<extra></extra>"
    ) |>
    add_trace(
      data = p_sub,
      x = ~year_month,
      y = ~favorability,
      name = "Party Favorability",
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      connectgaps = TRUE,
      line = list(color = "#2E7D32", width = 2),
      marker = list(color = "#2E7D32", size = 5),
      visible = is_visible,
      hovertemplate = "<b>Party Favorability</b><br>Date: %{x}<br>Favorability: %{y}%<extra></extra>"
    )
}

# Create dropdown menu buttons for each president
buttons <- lapply(seq_along(presidents), \(i) {
  pres <- presidents[i]
  vis <- rep(FALSE, length(presidents) * 3)
  vis[(3 * (i - 1) + 1):(3 * i)] <- TRUE

  list(
    method = "update",
    args = list(
      list(visible = as.list(vis)),
      list(
        title = list(
          text = paste("Ratings During Administration of", pres),
          x = 0.5,
          xanchor = "center"
        ),
        xaxis = list(title = "Date", autorange = TRUE)
      )
    ),
    label = pres
  )
})

# Layout configuration with dropdown menu, centered title, and 50% benchmark
fig <- fig |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste("Ratings During Administration of", presidents[1]),
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = 0.98,
      yanchor = "top"
    ),
    margin = list(t = 110, b = 60),
    xaxis = list(title = "Date", autorange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Rating (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "line",
        y0 = 50,
        y1 = 50,
        x0 = 0,
        x1 = 1,
        xref = "paper",
        line = list(color = "grey60", dash = "dash", width = 1)
      )
    ),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        active = 0,
        buttons = buttons,
        x = 0.0,
        y = 1.18,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "top"
      )
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.1, y = -0.2)
  )

fig
```
